title: Knowledge Source Management
summary: This module provides specialized classes for loading and processing various file types, including general files, diverse documents via Docling, and Excel spreadsheets, to serve as knowledge sources for RAG systems.

nodes.label: Base Knowledge Source
nodes.title: Abstract Knowledge Source
nodes.description: The abstract base class defining the fundamental interface and properties for all knowledge sources within the system.

nodes.label: Base File Source
nodes.title: Manage File-Based Knowledge
nodes.description: Provides common logic for handling file paths, validation, and content loading for knowledge sources that process local files, including methods for saving processed chunks.

nodes.label: Crew Docling Source
nodes.title: Process Diverse Documents
nodes.description: Converts various document types (PDF, DOCX, HTML, images, etc.) into structured content using the 'docling' library, then chunks and prepares them for knowledge retrieval.

nodes.label: Excel Knowledge Source
nodes.title: Extract Excel Data
nodes.description: Specializes in loading and processing Excel files, converting each sheet's content into CSV format for chunking and subsequent use as a knowledge source.

nodes.label: Knowledge Storage
nodes.title: Store Processed Knowledge
nodes.description: An external component responsible for persisting the chunked and processed knowledge from various sources, typically for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG).

nodes.label: Docling Library
nodes.title: Document Conversion Engine
nodes.description: An external library used by CrewDoclingSource to convert a wide array of document formats into a standardized, processable structure.

nodes.label: Pandas Library
nodes.title: Data Manipulation for Excel
nodes.description: An external library utilized by ExcelKnowledgeSource for reading, parsing, and converting Excel spreadsheet data into a structured format (CSV).

groups.label: File Processing Logic
groups.title: Core File Processing Components
groups.description: Contains the main components responsible for handling, validating, and loading content from various file types.

groups.label: Knowledge Storage
groups.title: Knowledge Persistence Layer
groups.description: Represents the mechanism for storing processed and chunked knowledge for later retrieval.

groups.label: External Libraries
groups.title: Third-Party Dependencies
groups.description: Includes external libraries crucial for specific document and data processing tasks.
